monitorTime.description:
Represents the start time of an execution of a {@link MlModel.Monitoring.Job}.
This field is dynamically populated during execution of {@link MlModel.Monitor.Job}.
If user needs to provide a `monitorTime` for use cases such as reproducing results of prior execution,
it is recommended that users provide {@link MlModel.Monitor.Context} for {@link MlModel.Monitor.Job#start}
with appropriate `monitorTime`.

title:
Context for {@link MlModel.Monitor.Job} execution.
An instance of this {@link MlModel.Monitor.Context} is used for customization of fetching
inputs (predictions, label, or scoring context) in {@link MlModel.Monitor.Data#dataGroupsFromSpec}.
name: MlModel.Monitor.Context
